blocks.html: Net Promoter Score (NPS) is a customer loyalty metric that measures how likely customers are to recommend a company’s product or service to others, typically based on a standardized survey scal

NPS is widely used to gauge customer satisfaction and brand loyalty. It helps businesses understand overall customer sentiment and identify areas for improvement. Customers are grouped into promoters, passives, and detractors based on their responses, providing a clear measure of advocacy.
NPS is calculated by asking customers a single question:

items.html: “How likely are you to recommend us to a friend or colleague?” (rated 0–10)

blocks.html: Identifies brand advocates and at-risk customers
If 60% of customers are promoters and 20% are detractors, the NPS score is 40.
Net Promoter Score is a simple yet powerful metric for understanding customer loyalty and satisfaction. It helps businesses track sentiment and improve long-term relationships.
